reference_ramp.clock_basis: zero during stance_handoff; completed stance_dwell steps plus one for the upcoming command

profiles.rule: Start the separately owned stance reference at V18's existing flexed target. Smoothly interpolate joint-space references to the unchanged neutral goal over the first 60 dwell commands, then remain exactly neutral. Preserve every pre-stance command, the 0.1-second response, 0.5 measured-velocity damping, 0.75 rad/s motor speed cap, impulse caps, body, walking policy, standing evaluator and 240-step stance timeout. This is a reference trajectory, not an observed pose or guaranteed foot-placement path.
profiles.parameter_basis: Use the existing -0.25 rad knee origin, zero terminal target, 120 Hz timestep and 0.75 rad/s stance cap. Smoothstep has peak normalized derivative 1.5, so 60 steps (0.5 s) bound the largest reference-coordinate speed at 1.5*0.25/0.5 = 0.75 rad/s. This also reaches the terminal reference before the earliest possible consecutive-60 standing completion. No duration is fitted to observed success or timeout. Reference speed is not a guarantee of actual joint speed, contact, stability, or recovery.
